Question
========
What topic is addressed in the data collection and access section of a DMP?

Answerlist
----------
* How data will be collected and who can access it
* How to improve accessibility and reproducibility of collected data
* What qualifications and education level are required to collect data
* What authorities have the legal right to demand data from the organization


Solution
========
The data collection and access section explains how data will be collected and who can access it.

Answerlist
----------
* True
* False
* False
* False
